d:
Descendants are humankind best defender against the alien threat, Bunny is one of the descendant, a speedster whose power comes from the lightning emitted from her body.

One day while Bunny is in a mission, she encounters a strange living masses of flesh hanging from the wall and ceiling. When she gets close to investigate it, she gets attacked by the tentacles from the wall of flesh and they wrap around her body tightly leaving her unable to use her power. With Bunny helpless to fight back, the tentacles then enters her body through her orifices and slowly corrupts her mind... After a while Bunny becomes infected and her body then serves the hivemind, which uses her to lure other descendants here and corrupts more victims...
